svg.title: Marfa Project - 1989
svg.desc: A front-facing, aged ivory Macintosh on a wooden pedestal, with its wired mouse, a blue disk with a clipped corner, timber-framed windows, a warm plaster wall to the left, and a wooden bench supporting a white marble squiggle sculpture to the right. Drawn from the project's reference photographs.

svg.title: Chromie Squiggle #7515 by Snowfro, upside-down animated sticker
